headline: 愛丁堡藝穗獨角戲《長頸鹿》
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節有齣新的獨角戲《Giraffe》，艾比蓋兒．韋恩斯托克（Abigail Weinstock）自編自演。劇中角色伊莉安娜（Eliana）今年 30 歲，被抓到在鄰居臥室裝了偷拍偷錄設備，鐵證如山卻還想著怎麼鑽法律漏洞——這齣戲在愛丁堡 Pleasance Courtyard 演到 8 月 31 日。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh An unlikely relationship blossoms in Abigail Weinstock’s compelling and touching solo drama It takes a brave writer/performer to make her character a sociopath. How to keep the audience on board with someone who is callous and indifferent? In Abigail Weinstock’s sparkling one-woman show, 30-year-old Eliana has been caught making clandestine recordings in her neighbour’s bedroom and cannot deny it. A court summons follows. Even then, her first thought is how to game the system. At Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh , until 31 August All our Edinburgh festival reviews Continue reading...

voice_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節有齣新的獨角戲，叫做《長頸鹿》。編劇兼主演艾比蓋兒．韋恩斯托克（Abigail Weinstock），演的是 30 歲的伊莉安娜（Eliana）——她被抓到在鄰居臥室裡偷偷錄影，鐵證如山，第一個念頭卻是想怎麼鑽法律漏洞。這齣戲在愛丁堡的 Pleasance Courtyard 演到 8 月 31 日。
